texts.zh: 多亏了额外的安全系统以及紧急协议，斯克兰德的旗舰在受到严重损坏后仍成功进行了紧急超光速跃迁。尽管出现在我们首都星球上方的残骸几乎无法被识别为一艘舰船，但船体依然可以作为重建的基础。这些残骸现在正在船坞等待修理。或者，我们可以对船体进行材料回收。考虑到它的状态，即便是我们认定这艘舰船的残骸无法修复的，斯克兰德也会理解这个决定。
texts.en: Thanks to additional failsafe systems and emergency protocols, Skrands' flagship managed to enter emergency FTL even after taking critical damage. Although what appeared in the skies above our capital world is barely recognizable as a ship, the hull can serve as a basis for rebuilding. The remains are now waiting at the docks for repairs. Alternatively, we could the hull for materials. Given its state, even Skrand would understand the decision if we deemed the wreck impossible to repair.

label.en: Scrap it, we need the alloys.

texts.zh: 利爪号被毁了。但我们已有的知识应该足以将回收来的残骸作为基础，使其能够重新运转。
texts.en: The Talon was destroyed. But given all we have learned, we should be able to use its recovered remains as a base to make it operational once again.

texts.zh: 在利爪号工程师团队的密切支持和监督下，我们成功地重建了船体。利爪号再度启航！
texts.en: With the close support and supervision of the Talon's engineering team, we were able to rebuild the hull. The Talon takes flight again!
